details.judge_reply:
Explanation:  
The Ground Truth Answer states that Edmund Fitzgerald was born in 1895 and would have been 80 years old in 1975. The Predicted Answer claims that Edmund Fitzgerald died in 1957, and by the time the ship sank in 1975, he had been dead for approximately 18 years. The essential fact in the Ground Truth is the information about his birth year and thus his possible age at the time of the sinking, assuming he were still alive. The Predicted Answer assumes he was deceased and gives the length of time since his death. 

However, the Predicted Answer contains incorrect factual information: Edmund Fitzgerald actually died in 1986, not 1957. Moreover, the core content of the Ground Truth—that he would have been 80 years old in 1975—is not present at all in the Predicted Answer. The focus in the Predicted Answer is entirely on an erroneous death year and does not provide his age in 1975 or even a correct calculation related to the Ground Truth. Thus, the substance of the Ground Truth is NOT present in the Predicted Answer.

Decision: FALSE
